name: mfec-pika-arena
description: MFEC Pika Arena: live quiz and icebreaker game for MFEC teams, built from the Pika wiki

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @pika-arena/server" "npm run dev -w @pika-arena/web"
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run start -w @pika-arena/server" "npm run start -w @pika-arena/web"
